parsed.visual_overview: A vertical split-screen video where an AI teacher and a human learner engage in a rapid-fire Marathi-to-English translation drill. In the second half, they discuss the Supernova AI app, accompanied by app UI overlays, ending with a final download call-to-action.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: तुम्ही Red म्हणा, मी Black म्हणते. चला, सुरु करूया.
Snehal says: Yes, सुरु करूया.
Miss Nova says: मी आता नाश्ता करत आहे.
Snehal says: I am having breakfast right now.
Miss Nova says: तुम्ही कुठे जात आहात?
Snehal says: Where are you going?
Miss Nova says: मला थोडं पाणी द्या ना.
Snehal says: Please give me some water.
Miss Nova says: आज खूप गरम आहे.
Snehal says: It is very hot today.
Miss Nova says: मी तुम्हाला नंतर फोन करते.
Snehal says: I will call you later.
Miss Nova says: मला हे समजलं नाही.
Snehal says: I did not understand this.
Miss Nova says: तुम्ही माझी मदत करू शकता का?
Snehal says: Can you help me?
Miss Nova says: Perfect! आता शेवटचं वाक्य, मला इंग्लिश बोलायला शिकायचं आहे.
Snehal says: I want to learn how to speak English.
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Tumhi Red mhana, mi Black mhante. Chala, suru karuya.
Snehal says: Yes, suru karuya.
Miss Nova says: Mi aata nashta karat aahe.
Snehal says: I am having breakfast right now.
Miss Nova says: Tumhi kuthe jaat aahat?
Snehal says: Where are you going?
Miss Nova says: Mala thoda pani dya na.
Snehal says: Please give me some water.
Miss Nova says: Aaj khoop garam aahe.
Snehal says: It is very hot today.
Miss Nova says: Mi tumhala nantar phone karte.
Snehal says: I will call you later.
Miss Nova says: Mala he samajla nahi.
Snehal says: I did not understand this.
Miss Nova says: Tumhi majhi madat karu shakta ka?
Snehal says: Can you help me?
Miss Nova says: Perfect! Aata shevatcha vakya, mala English bolayla shikaycha aahe.
Snehal says: I want to learn how to speak English.

scenes.scene_label: App Pitch and Call to Action
scenes.script_native:
Snehal says: (smiling) Wow, हे खूप easy होतं! पण मला रोज practice करायची असेल तर?
Miss Nova says: त्यासाठीच Supernova AI आहे. तुम्ही माझ्यासोबत रोज फक्त 10-15 minutes speaking practice करू शकता, आणि मी सगळं Marathi मध्ये explain करते.
Snehal says: आणि improvement किती दिवसात दिसेल?
Miss Nova says: Just 30 days मध्ये! 1 crore+ users आधीच माझ्यासोबत practice करत आहेत. आणि हो, हे offline classes पेक्षा सात पट स्वस्त आहे.
Snehal says: That sounds amazing! मी आत्ताच download करते.
Miss Nova says: Yes! आजच Supernova AI download करा.
scenes.script_roman:
Snehal says: (smiling) Wow, he khoop easy hota! Pan mala roj practice karaychi asel tar?
Miss Nova says: Tyasathich Supernova AI aahe. Tumhi majhyasobat roj fakta 10-15 minutes speaking practice karu shakta, aani mi sagala Marathi madhye explain karte.
Snehal says: Aani improvement kiti divsat disel?
Miss Nova says: Just 30 days madhye! 1 crore+ users aadhich majhyasobat practice karat aahet. Aani ho, he offline classes peksha saat pat swast aahe.
Snehal says: That sounds amazing! Mi aattach download karte.
Miss Nova says: Yes! Aajach Supernova AI download kara.
